Description

Adaptive Proportion Test Low Threshold (two-sided NIST SP 800-90B compliance). Detects low-bias noise where too few 1s are observed per bit lane. The APT counts 1s per bit lane over a health test window; if the minimum count across all lanes falls below this threshold, the test fails (apt_test_fail_lo). For window_size=2048 with good entropy, expect ~1024 ones per lane. Default=848 (41.4% of 2048, symmetric 5-sigma margin below mean, matching the high threshold at 1200=58.6%).

Field Descriptions

LIMIT

APT low count threshold. Test fails if the minimum per-bit-lane ones count falls below this value at window wrap. Set to 0 to disable the low-side test. 16-bit width supports window sizes up to 8192.
